title: Boundary from a fixed normalized section resolution
statement: Let X be a scheme, U,V opens covering X, F an abelian etale sheaf, I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and c a normalized section homology comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Let S be its restriction-pair/difference section short complex [def-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-section-complex]. Degreewise injectivity and the covering hypothesis make S short exact [lem-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-injective-sections-exact]. Define the additive boundary in degree q by c.globalEquiv(q+1) composed with the homology connecting map of S, composed with the inverse of c.openEquiv(U intersection V,q). It maps the actual restricted cohomology H^q(U intersection V,F|) to H^(q+1)(X,F). No existential boundary or unspecified comparison is chosen. With a supplied open W and equality W=U intersection V, construct etaleSectionShortComplexOn directly on the section terms X,U,V,W, taking its inclusion proofs from the equality. Its short exactness follows by substituting the equality into the standard section short complex. Define etaleMayerVietorisBoundaryOn from this directly constructed short complex and c.openEquiv(W,q). Its data contains no equality transport of a cohomology group; the equality occurs only in inclusion and exactness proofs. The irreducible fixed-boundary interface fixes the injective resolution and the normalized comparison, which is determined on cocycles, and exposes the boundary without expanding those data. The fixed resolution and its normalized comparison are exposed as separate irreducible typed constants, etaleMayerVietorisFixedResolution and etaleMayerVietorisFixedComparison; the boundary API uses these constants without repeating their instance/choice construction.
